messages:
maya: Quick update — I spun up the new candidate (aurora-11b int6) on a small dedicated pool for early ops checks. Quick smoke numbers below, happy for a short call if needed.

maya: ```
p50: 34ms
p95: 89ms
tokens/s (single-stream): 45
cost/unit (tokens): 0.72x vs saffron-11b-int8
observed regressions: longform summarization slice (~2% drop in ROUGE-L on legal summarizer)
```

paul: Nice. Cost looks promising. Do we have throughput or batching impact numbers? Also which quant config (q6_k or int6-fast)?

maya: Using int6-fast (kernel-tuned); batching tests show similar perf to int8 up to batch=8, drops after batch=16. Throughput for mixed workloads is +10% on average.

jen: Can you paste one of the longform failure examples? We need to see if it's a priming/format problem or a model regression.

maya: Example prompt (redacted): 

maya: ```
IN: "Summarize the following 6-page contract focusing on indemnity, termination, and liability caps."
OUT (aurora-int6): "The agreement ends if either party violates the clause."  <-- hallucinated termination cause (not in doc)
OUT (saffron-int8): properly lists clauses, no hallucination
```

paul: Hmm, that looks like a hallucination on long context. Could be a KV cache or attention precision edge-case with int6.

alec: Recommendation from product side: hold GTN exposure for now. Run targeted 10k-slice eval on longform and financial/legal slices, and add shadow-traffic for 48h. If good, we can A/B with 10% traffic and an automatic fallback to saffron-int8 for flagged slices.

maya: Agreed. Ops playbook I suggest: 1) run 1k curated longform eval (prod prompts) 2) enable priming tweak (+explicit directive for "do not invent facts") 3) shadow traffic + automatic reroute on hallucination signal (we have a quick detector) 4) re-run quant-kernel tests with q6_k variant.

paul: Sounds good. For unit econ guidance: if eval passes, we can recommend routing policy that sends low-latency chat to aurora-int6 (savings ~28% per token) and routes >2k-token docs to saffron-int8 until further validation.

jen: Also add a QA check to track semantic drift on the legal slice daily for first week post-rollout. Put the failing examples into a taggable dataset so PMs can review.

maya: I'll kick off the 1k eval now and push the shadow config. Linking infra task: https://redwood.internal/tasks/infra/aurora-int6-smoke (ops-visibility).

ops-bot: deploy:shadow-config aurora-int6 -> accepted (job 8842). ETA: 2m.

paul: Thanks — keep updates short in this thread. If we see >1% absolute ROUGE-L drop on the legal slice in the 1k eval, we hold. Otherwise proceed to staged A/B with 10% traffic and int8 fallback. :thumbsup:
